mod.name: Automated Buildings
mod.description:
Three new passive production modules that run without crew. Power and input items go in, finished output comes out. Logistic bots haul I/O automatically.
Modules: - Auto-Builder — generates Build Tools from raw materials. A buffed, autonomous Tool Generator. - Auto-Fab — fabricates Construction Materials from refined ores. - Auto-Greenhouse — grows algae food from water and bio matter.
All three use the vanilla `<produces>` + `<stateWatchdog autoproduce="true">` pattern. No Java, no AI — just data.
mod.author: mingc
